description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields such as room number, check-in date, departure date, total consumption, total payment, and detailed consumption list
description_zh: 支持包括房号、入住日期、离店日期、消费总计、付款总计、消费详单等关键字段结构化识别输出
